text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this would look great on Dia-chan! 
It's so elegant and cute... fufu. If she 
wore this, she'd look just like a fairy~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This would look amazing on Suzuka-san! 
It has such a mature, calm feel... like a 
goddess!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, you two should be looking for 
clothes for yourselves! ...Ah, wait, 
wouldn't that look great on the President—

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! You're Tokai Teio-san, Special 
Week-san... and Kitasan Black-san, right?!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
I'm a huge fan of all of you... Thank you 
so much for always showing us such 
wonderful races!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A fan... wonderful races!? Awawa...! I-I'm 
so happy! To hear someone say that to 
us...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Those runs were only possible because of 
everyone's support! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, think nothing of it♪ Want an 
autograph? Got a pen on you~?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?! Th-Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look over there. They already have 
"Traces of Horse Girls" that just came out 
yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a Horse Girl corner, huh? Hm hm, 
they've got plenty of my merch nicely 
displayed too! Impressive, impressive♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I'm on the cover...! Hyaa~! I hope I 
don't look weird or anything, desu_ne!?

text_block_list.name: Rental Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah, everyone! All of your races up until 
now have been truly unforgettable and 
spectacular...!

text_block_list.name: Rental Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I was so moved that I couldn't resist 
setting up a massive Horse Girl corner 
display!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You went that far...? ...Thank you so 
much! That makes me incredibly happy, 
desu!

Now that their busy days had finally 
settled down, the three hoped to enjoy a 
relaxing time off, but after that—

text_block_list.name: Fan Wearing a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Special Week-san! I love watching you run 
with all your heart, it's so cute and 
inspiring...

text_block_list.name: Fan Wearing a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
I want to become someone who can always be 
cheerful and smiling like you!

text_block_list.name: Student Fan
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't play in my basketball games 
because of an injury... and I was ready to 
give up on everything! But watching you, 
Teio-san—

text_block_list.name: Student Fan
text_block_list.text:
Made me realize that I can still keep 
going!

text_block_list.name: Housewife Fan
text_block_list.text:
Your tenacity and resilience! I'm honestly 
just captivated by it!

text_block_list.name: Housewife Fan
text_block_list.text:
Not getting discouraged by ordinary 
setbacks, I really ought to take a page 
from your book!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Wow, today was really something, 
wasn't it? Even I got a bit flustered, and 
I'm totally used to it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-It was incredible. Everywhere we went, 
people called out to us... To know so many 
people are cheering for us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, my heart is pounding.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We've run in so many races, fought on 
famous big stages...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Reaching a milestone like this feels... 
somehow a little bittersweet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know what you mean! It feels kind of 
like when a festival comes to an end, desu 
ne.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I felt a little bit of that too. ...But.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
None of the people cheering for us had sad 
looks on their faces, not even a bit!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Even as they left, they told us, 
"Keep giving it your all!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...My heart feels so full. We really came 
this far with the support of so many 
people, desu ne.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And of course, not just the fans. Our 
friends who trained alongside us too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And our irreplaceable rivals, as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. And I'm sure that even if we hit 
milestones, there's no real end.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna keep on running, and leave 
behind even more sparkling memories for 
tons of people.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Together with everyone, of course!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

The three gaze into the pale evening sky. 
The future memories they are destined to 
leave behind... They, too, will surely 
shine just as brightly.
